fn a(h: HANDLE) {
    unsafe { TerminateProcess(h, 1) };
    unsafe { TerminateJobObject(h, 1) };
    Command::new("taskkill").args(["/T", "/F"]);
    root.join("taskkill.exe")
}

fn b() {
    std::process::Command::new("kill").arg("-9");
    paddock_proc::command("pkill");
    ps.arg("Stop-Process -Id 42 -Force");
    Command::new("/bin/kill");
    Command::new("/usr/bin/kill");
}

#[expect(clippy::disallowed_methods, reason = "ADR 0033 WP-5: killpg after reap")]
fn c() {}

// conformance: pid-kill — no
// ADR 0033 WP-7: x

#![cfg_attr(test, allow(clippy::disallowed_methods))]
